{"code":"import Mathlib

theorem fatem_020_field_ideal_eq_bot_or_top {F : Type*} [Field F] (I : Ideal F) :
    I = 0 ∨ I = ⊤ := by
  by_cases h : I = 0
  · exact Or.inl h
  · -- Case: I ≠ 0
    -- Since I ≠ 0, there exists x ∈ I such that x ≠ 0
    have h_exists : ∃ x ∈ I, x ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h_no
      -- If no such x exists, then for all x ∈ I, x = 0
      have h_all_zero : ∀ x ∈ I, x = 0 := by
        intro x hx
        by_contra hx_ne
        exact h_no ⟨x, hx, hx_ne⟩
      -- This implies I = 0
      have h_I_eq_zero : I = 0 := by
        apply Ideal.ext
        intro x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          exact h_all_zero x hx
        · intro hx
          rw [hx]
          exact Ideal.zero_mem _
      contradiction
    -- Obtain the non-zero element
    obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, hx_ne⟩ := h_exists
    -- In a field, non-zero elements are units
    have hx_unit : IsUnit x := by
      rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
      exact hx_ne
    -- If a unit is in I, then 1 ∈ I
    have h_one_mem : (1 : F) ∈ I := by
      -- Since x is a unit, x⁻¹ exists and x⁻¹ * x = 1
      -- Since I is an ideal and x ∈ I, x⁻¹ * x ∈ I
      have h_inv_mem : x⁻¹ * x ∈ I := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx_mem
      simpa [hx_unit] using h_inv_mem
    -- If 1 ∈ I, then I = ⊤
    have h_I_eq_top : I = ⊤ := by
      apply Ideal.eq_top_of_one_mem
      exact h_one_mem
    exact Or.inr h_I_eq_top"}
